title: Tips: a Help > Tips panel and an optional tip of the day, from one tips file in the repo (first tip: drive CamCraft from your AI agent via MCP)

labels.name: source:agent

labels.name: area:mcp

body:
Requested by mkinney (2026-11-20): "Should we add a tips or hints option somewhere in cc? The mcp would be a great first thing there". Many capabilities (MCP agents, undo of AI changes, the example catalog, verify before post) are only found by reading the guide.

## Proposal

- **Help > Tips**: a panel that lists all tips, each one short paragraph with an optional "Show me" action (open a guide page, or open the matching dialog when one exists).
- **Tip of the day** on the start screen, optional, with a "Don't show again" check box (a user preference). It never blocks work and never shows during a running job.
- **One source file** in the repo (for example `assets/tips/tips.toml`): id, title, text, optional guide link, optional UI action. Anyone adds a tip with a PR. The docs site can render the same file as a "Tips" page.
- Text follows the docs style; no tip promises a feature that is not shipped (a test checks that each guide link exists).
- MCP: a `list_tips` tool, so an agent can suggest them too (AGENTS.md: a user-facing addition carries its MCP tool, or a follow-up issue).

## First tips

1. **Drive CamCraft from your AI agent (MCP):** headless or attached to the open window; link to the per-client setup in the MCP guide (#3029).
2. **Every change can be undone:** Ctrl+Z (Cmd+Z on macOS) also undoes changes an AI agent made. Tips name the shortcut for the user's OS (Ctrl on Windows/Linux, Cmd on macOS), never one fixed key.
3. **Verify before you post:** what a refusal means and why CamCraft blocks an unsafe program.
4. **Start from an example:** the example catalog has a ready project for each operation (#2392).

Done means: Help > Tips shows the tips from the file; the tip of the day can be turned off and stays off; a structural UI test covers the panel; `list_tips` exists; the four tips above are in the file with working links.
